_about: p1 (14 Nov 2026): ML / LLM knowledge read by engine/mlstack.py. Every row names its source ids (kb/sources.json). Prices are on-demand Linux USD per hour from the official page or price API opened on 14 Nov 2026; sizing thresholds are planning heuristics in engine/mlstack.py, not here.

vllm.name: vLLM
vllm.fact: serves open-weight models behind an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server
vllm.lora_fact: loads LoRA adapters on top of one base model per request

triton.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
triton.fact: serves TensorRT, ONNX, PyTorch and vLLM back ends from one server

deepstream.name: NVIDIA DeepStream (GStreamer pipeline with TensorRT)
deepstream.fact: builds real-time multi-camera video analytics pipelines with TensorRT models on Jetson edge devices and on servers

onnxruntime-tensorrt.name: ONNX Runtime with the TensorRT execution provider
onnxruntime-tensorrt.fact: runs an exported ONNX model on NVIDIA GPUs through TensorRT; JetPack packages exist for Jetson

onnxruntime-cpu.name: ONNX Runtime (in-process)
onnxruntime-cpu.fact: loads an exported scikit-learn/XGBoost model inside the API

pgvector.name: pgvector (PostgreSQL extension)
pgvector.fact: open-source vector similarity search inside PostgreSQL with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes; HNSW uses more memory than IVFFlat

qdrant.name: Qdrant (self-hosted container)
qdrant.fact: runs as a container or binary on your own servers, with a Helm chart for Kubernetes and a private-cloud option without any cloud connection

pinecone.name: Pinecone
pinecone.fact: a hosted vector database (serverless indexes); no self-hosted edition is confirmed in the knowledge base

mlflow.name: MLflow (tracking server + Model Registry)
mlflow.fact: logs experiment runs (parameters, metrics, artifacts) and versions models in a registry

dvc.name: DVC (data version control)
dvc.fact: versions datasets next to the code in Git

gcp.name: Vertex AI Experiments + Vertex AI Model Registry
gcp.fact: provide managed experiment tracking and a model registry (Google now documents them under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)

aws.name: Amazon SageMaker Model Registry (+ experiment metrics on each model version)
aws.fact: catalogs models, manages versions and attaches training metrics and lineage

azure.name: Azure Machine Learning workspace (MLflow tracking + model registry)
azure.fact: acts as an MLflow-compatible tracking server and registers model versions

gpu_instances._note: rows per provider in rising GPU memory; usd_per_hour keyed by residency (us/eu/india); 'region' names the region the rate is for.
